source.content: normal human walk (BMLrub rub058), forward velocity ~1.6 m/s

method.name: SMPL-X forward-kinematics + closed-form 2-link sagittal IK (keypoint-based)
method.description: FK the SMPL-X skeleton (root_orient + pose_body via standard SMPL kintree + neutral bone vectors) to per-frame hip/knee/ankle 3D positions; solve 2-link IK (thigh+shin) for hip_pitch/knee_pitch in the root sagittal plane. Roll/yaw/ankle from frontal residual. No axis-guessing, no foreign joint indices.

smpl_joint_mapping.verification: knees 4/5 confirmed antiphase (cross-corr -0.65 at gait lag)

method.joint_mapping: SMPL leg joints -> X1 URDF dof_names order (12 DOF), explicit by name

coordinate_system.world: X1 Z-up (+X forward, +Y left, +Z up); source SMPL Y-up rotated (X1x=SMPLx, X1y=SMPLz, X1z=SMPLy)
coordinate_system.root_rotation: heading yaw only (SMPL T-pose constant tilt stripped)
coordinate_system.root_height: pelvis set to X1 init height 0.7m, vertical bob preserved

foot_contact.method: stance when ankle forward-velocity below its median (biomechanical planted-foot criterion)

validation.headless_numpy: validate_retarget.py 19/19 PASS (schema, finite, unit-quats, range, continuity, contact, MotionLib round-trip)

gate_b_checks.mujoco_kinematic_replay: PASS (no penetration, no self-collision, base in walking range)
gate_b_checks.note: Clip is non-looping (walk segment); AMP MotionLib handles non-loop clips. Loopable=false is recorded, not forced.
